user.title: Freezer Inventory
user.description: Freezer inventory, item by item and piece by piece.

invalid_name.message: The name must be 2 to 80 characters long.

invalid_category.message: Invalid category: use carne, verdura, frutta or altro.

invalid_weight.message: Invalid weight: must be between 1 g and 50 kg.

quantity_weights_mismatch.message: Quantity {quantity} does not match the number of values ({weights}).

item_not_found.message: Item not found (maybe already taken or deleted).

empty_pieces.message: An item needs at least one piece: use "Delete item" to remove it.

invalid_piece.message: Invalid piece: give either a weight or portions, not both.

invalid_amount.message: Invalid value: grams (e.g. 250, 0.5kg) or portions (whole number below 10, e.g. 4; above that write "12 por").

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds a new item to the freezer. Always creates a new item, even if the name already exists.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Number of pieces without weight (ignored if weights are given).

weights.name: Weights or portions
weights.description: Optional: one value per piece. Numbers from 10 up = grams (also 0.5kg), below 10 = portions; e.g. "300 0.5kg 4".

add_piece.name: Add piece
add_piece.description: Adds a piece to an existing item, dated today.

portions.name: Portions
portions.description: Optional: number of portions in the piece.

amount.name: Weight or portions (text)
amount.description: Optional, alternative to the two fields: "250", "0.5kg", "4" (portions), "12 por".

take_piece.name: Take piece
take_piece.description: Removes a piece; without a piece ID the oldest is taken. Taking the last piece deletes the item.

update_item.name: Update item
update_item.description: Fixes name, category, note or the piece list.

pieces.name: Pieces
pieces.description: Replaces the list: pieces with "id" are updated, without "id" created, unlisted ones removed. Per piece "amount" (text, e.g. "4" or "250") or "weight_g"/"portions", plus optional "added_at".

delete_item.name: Delete item
delete_item.description: Deletes an item with all its pieces.

undo_last.name: Undo last operation
undo_last.description: Reverts the most recent operation not yet undone.

list_items.name: List items
list_items.description: Returns the items, filtered and sorted.
